Team / NexusBank infra,

Following our SOW call last week, NexusBank has asked for a concise runbook and a canonical inventory that ties private-cluster artifacts to custody proof for EU and APAC sites. I put together a draft inventory (attached) and a short activation checklist — please review for gaps. Key asks from Nexus:

- Single-sheet inventory mapping: cluster ID, region, KMS key id, storage custody (snapshots vs block), retention window, and evidence pointers.
- Failover activation steps that preserve EU custody requirements for customer A while allowing APAC warm-standby activation for B.
- Explicit gating for KMS access and cross-jurisdiction key use (we cannot export keys across EU boundary).

Immediate requests: can engineering confirm the following by EOD?
1) Which clusters are cold (require >2h to bring fully online) vs warm? (fill column "activation_latency" in the CSV)
2) Where do we maintain immutable snapshots vs live replication (and what retention policy applies)?
3) Which operators require NexusBank network peering changes during activation (firewall, BGP)?

I've attached: residency-inventory.csv, eu-apac-activation-checklist.xlsx, and a current network-diagram-v2.vsdx. Nexus, if you can attach any internal evidence IDs (ticket numbers or audit logs) that point to custody acceptance, that will help the later compliance pack.

Next step: I'll collate and draft a 2-page runbook that we can hand to Nexus and the audit team.

Thanks,
Hannah

Thanks Hannah — quick answers inline and a couple of open questions.

On activation_latency:
- eu-cluster-3: cold (~3.5h) — we need manual node replacement + KMS file mount checks.
- eu-cluster-5: warm (~25m) — prefix cache and leader election only.
- apac-cluster-2: warm (~30m) but requires peering churn (~15m) for customer-facing egress.

Snapshots vs replication:
- We take immutable daily snapshots (S3-backed, EU legal bucket) for EU clusters; retention 90 days by default.
- APAC uses async replication to local object store for faster RTO (7 days retention).

KMS gating: EU clusters are bound to a regional KMS key (kms-eu-0xA1). We cannot export the key; for APAC failover we generate per-tenant ephemeral keys but cannot use kms-eu-0xA1 in APAC. That means any encrypted-at-rest tokens that reference kms-eu-0xA1 need a rewrap step during activation.

Open questions:
1) Nexus: will you allow our temporary cross-account IAM role for the rewrap operation, or must rewrap be done by your operations team?
2) Marissa/Jonas: I listed an operator group "netops-failover" — who owns that and do we have runbook access for Nexus peering changes?

I attached a short CSV with my preliminary notes (column "activation_latency"). I'll update once Nexus answers the IAM/rewrap question.

- Karthik
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime

Hannah, Karthik, team,

Thanks for the draft. A couple of clarifications from NexusBank infra and SecOps:

- We will not perform key rewraps for keys we own (kms-eu-*). If the rewrap operation requires access to our KMS, Nexus can perform the rewrap but will need a documented request template and an operator window.
- For APAC warm activations, Nexus allows ephemeral routing changes (BGP withdraw/add) during an approved maintenance window. We need explicit commands and expected timing from your runbook so our NOC can authorize.
- Evidence pointers: we can provide the following once the inventory is finalized — ticket IDs for custody acceptance (NB-2028-4053), audit log slices for snapshot creation dates (S3: nb-eu-snap-202807), and a PDF of our legal acceptance letter.

Action items from Nexus: please add two columns to the inventory CSV: "nexus_acceptance_ticket" and "rewrap_owner". For anything labeled rewrap_owner=Nexus, we will expect a DocuSign-approved authorization before the operation.

On failover semantics: Nexus prefers a two-stage activation for EU tenants — 1) bring compute up in APAC behind a non-production VLAN to validate behavior without writing new EU-bound artifacts, then 2) perform an authorized rewrap and cutover. That approach preserves custody evidence.

We'll attach the acceptance ticket ID to the thread once we provision it.

Regards,
NexusBank Infra Team
infra@nexusbank.com
